text:
evan-sales: Quick one 50k user app wants a 4-week POC. They asked recommended reserved GPUs + autoscale and whether we can hit 99.9% availability. Workload: chat + embeddings. Steady ~200 rps, spikes to ~1k for 10-12m. Avg input 100 tokens. Need VPC peering and SOC2 artifacts. Any immediate blockers?

mika-sre: No blockers. Re: sizing: assume ~320 rps per GPU with q4 quant. For steady 200 rps, 2 reserved GPUs minimal but for SLA and headroom propose 5 reserved + autoscale to 15. Spread across AZs (min 2/az).

ryan-runtime: Agree. Add preheat_window 6m and KV-warmup cron. Autoscale sample:
```yaml
reserved: 5
max: 15
target_rps_per_gpu: 320
preheat: 6m
cooldown: 90s
```

zoe-solutions: For POC we recommend capped burst credits (e.g., 6k minutes) and a 48hr smoke run before GA to validate tail latency against golden prompts.

ian-pricing: Pricing: 5 reserved GPUs fixed + burst billed at on-demand. Ill add a premium SLA option (higher reserved + priority routing) if customer insists on lower tail latency. Need estimated monthly burst minutes to finalize numbers.

claire-security: SOC2 docs ready. For VPC peering need their CIDR list and an NDA for logs. Customer-managed KMS is enterprise-only (longer lead).

evan-sales: Legal asked for 50ms 50p SLA for chat  realistic?

ryan-runtime: Not at this model/size. Propose 50p <250ms for chat standard; embeddings 50p <120ms. Premium SLA can be model + commit change.

mika-sre: Ops checklist: add queue-depth alerts, model pinning in deployment, rollback to smaller model variant, and smoke test link to runbook.

evan-sales: Next steps: Ill ask for CIDRs and burst cadence, ian will draft pricing (std + premium), zoe will schedule smoke, mika will prep sandbox pool. Thanks all :thumbsup:
